about_the_game:
You find yourself in the underground city of Blackchapel, where misery and despair reign. Fortunately, you recently found a huge drill to take you to the surface. You'll need to fuel it with a mysterious substance, which can only be obtained by recovering bodies. Fight your way through the monsters to recover the bodies of the victims they left behind. If they try to contact you, don't respond; they can understand you. 

Find Bodies

You'll have to make your way through the dark alleys of Blackchapel to find bodies.

Transform Them

Transform bodies into black phosphors at the Blackchapel General Processing Plant to fuel your motorized drill.

Refuel Your Drill and Flee to the surface

Power your motorized drill to escape this hell and return to the surface abandoned for far too long.

content_descriptors.notes:
In Blackchapel you can play as a 19th-century prostitute, who will have to collect money, the game does not contain any explicit sexual acts or relationships. The prostitutes are hunted by a serial killer and in some cases are murdered, the game contains blood effects and violence. 

This may not be suitable for all audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11, 10
  • Processor: 4-core 3 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: In this co-op horror game, you'll have to dodge monsters of all kinds to recover the bodies they left behind and transform them into a mysterious substance to feed your motorized drill. You'll finally have the means to save yourself from this cursed city. But be careful, monsters can understand you.
